## SPA Def1

### Def
SinglePageApp (SPA) is a webApp that interacts with the user by dynamically rewriting the current web page with new data from the web server, instead of the default method of a webBrowser loading entire new pages from a server.

### CTP
Include using JavaScript frameworks | libs to handle UI rendering, client-side routing, & state management, which allows for a more fluid & responsive user experience !w full page reloads.

### Ex 
```{html}
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <title>SPA Example</title>
    <script src="https://unpkg.com/react@18/umd/react.development.js" crossorigin></script>
    <script src="https://unpkg.com/react-dom@18/umd/react-dom.development.js" crossorigin></script>
    <script src="https://unpkg.com/babel-standalone@6/babel.min.js"></script>
</head>
<body>
    <div id="root"></div>
    <script type="text/babel">
        const App = () => <h1>Hello, SPA!</h1>;
        ReactDOM.render(<App />, document.getElementById('root'));
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```

## SPA - Single Page Architecture

### Def
A design pattern where the entire application is served in a single HTML page, and the application dynamically updates the content based on user interactions.

### CTP
Involves modularization of the application into components, client-side routing to simulate different pages, and AJAX or Fetch API to load data without reloading the page.

### Ex 
```{javascript}
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import ReactDOM from 'react-dom';

const App = () => {
    const [content, setContent] = useState('Home');

    const handleNavigation = (newContent) => {
        setContent(newContent);
    };

    return (
        <div>
            <nav>
                <button onClick={() => handleNavigation('Home')}>Home</button>
                <button onClick={() => handleNavigation('About')}>About</button>
            </nav>
            <h1>{content}</h1>
        </div>
    );
};

ReactDOM.render(<App />, document.getElementById('root'));
```

## SPA - Single Page Apartment

### Def
A living space in a multi-story building, typically consisting of one level or part of a level, providing complete independent living facilities for one or more persons.

### CTP
Characteristics include private entrances, separate kitchens and bathrooms, and self-contained living areas within a larger building structure.

### Ex 
```{md}
# Layout of a Typical SPA
- Living Room
- Kitchen
- Master Bedroom
- Bathroom
- Balcony
```

## SPA - Single Page Area

### Def
A web development concept where all the content is managed within a single page, often used in the context of web design and user interface development.

### CTP
Emphasizes user experience through minimal page reloads and dynamic content updates, enhancing interactivity and reducing load times.

### Ex 
```{html}
<div id="app">
    <button onclick="loadContent('home')">Home</button>
    <button onclick="loadContent('about')">About</button>
    <div id="content"></div>
</div>
<script>
function loadContent(page) {
    document.getElementById('content').innerHTML = 'Loading ' + page + '...';
    setTimeout(() => {
        document.getElementById('content').innerHTML = 'Content of ' + page;
    }, 500);
}
</script>
```

::: {.callout-note}
Note: The most common technical meaning of SPA is related to Single Page Applications, which are widely used in modern web development for creating dynamic and responsive web interfaces.
:::
